periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonal slant directed downward and outward at approximately 45 degrees from the nasal bridge.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval, with the vertical-diagonal axis significantly exceeding the transverse width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Significant downward taper extending toward the lower maxillary region, creating a teardrop morphology.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Broad, shallow U-shape with a relatively flat posterior boundary across the spinal midline.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Thick transverse band occupying roughly one-third of the visible distance between the neck and the hindquarters.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral displacement with a broad white cranial gap between the dark auricular regions.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: High degree of curvature smoothness, exhibiting a consistent semicircular arc at the superior boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced brownish-yellow staining or rufous tinting on the white pelage of the mid-dorsal and posterior regions.
